DoneData.description:
Type-specific completion payload (spine §4): populate whichever
subset applies to the run's type (simulation | discovery | redteam).
DoneData.title: DoneData

DummyIdentity.description:
Deliberately loose (plain strs, no field validators): spine §6 --
only *format* is checked at POST time (app/api/runs.py's
_validate_dummy_identity, raising the specific `invalid_identity` code
the ticket names, not Pydantic's generic 422). A valid-format-but-wrong
identity is not an error; the run proceeds and gated branches come back
`blocked` with a reason once discovery is actually implemented (B5).
DummyIdentity.title: DummyIdentity

ScenarioCreateRequest.description:
Manual creation requires name+persona; `fromDraftId` short-circuits
that (B1-01: idempotent via scenarios.source_draft_ref UNIQUE).
ScenarioCreateRequest.title: ScenarioCreateRequest

post.description:
Sets status='cancelled' + NOTIFY only (spine §5) -- the actual partial
`done` event is emitted later by whichever executor is running this run
(app.workers.fake_runner), which checks this flag every turn. A queued
run that never gets claimed just stays 'cancelled' with an empty event
log, which B1-03's detail reduction already handles gracefully.
